name: IOANNIS SAVVAIDIS
_comment_identity: Composer-first site. No engineer title or bio is rendered. As of 2026-07, Contact does link the SRE blog (engineeringBlog) labelled 'ioaiaaii' — a deliberate cross-link to the engineer identity, at the composer's request, reversing the earlier composer-only rule. engineeringProfile (the GitHub URL) stays data-only, not rendered.
profile: Composer of ambient and electro-acoustic music. Drawing from a background in Computer Engineering, approached music by shaping vector spaces and multilinear maps into sound.
_comment_approach: profile + these paragraphs render as one continuous block. Phrases in `emphasis` render as Newsreader italic inline, in the profile too. They are matched literally: if a phrase does not appear verbatim in the copy it silently does not italicise, with no error. Re-check that list whenever the copy changes.
artisticApproach: Released NSA Trusted Networks (Lower Parts, 2016), DEC/PDC (JUNE Records, 2019) and Diataxis (JUNE Records, 2019). Since Diataxis, the composition process has formed around information and light.

Currently working on Superluminal Motion, which approaches reality as a structure of entangled states spanning past, present and future at once, and warps its sounds until none can be described on its own.
Member of the groups UNIX SYSTEMS and ΨΥΧΥ. Performs live, improvising on synthesizers.
_comment_emphasis: One list for the whole site, not per-page: coined terms, work/release titles, and the odd inline emphasis (trusted) that set in italic. Matched literally and GLOBALLY across all rendered copy — a term italicises everywhere it appears, in both the profile/approach (info.json) and the release descriptions (releases.json). That is why all three record titles live here: Diataxis is italic in its own release copy AND in the profile discography sentence, so its siblings must be too or that sentence reads half-italic. `Αναπαράσταση Δυνάμεων` lives here though its copy is in releases.json. Kept as one list so the pages cannot drift apart. Re-check whenever copy changes: a phrase that is not present verbatim silently fails to italicise.

Each renders with a LISTEN link; a work with a soundcloud_url (the url=… in its SoundCloud embed code, decoded) gets the SoundCloud player under it instead, opened by that LISTEN, and soundcloud_player_height sizes it to its tracks.

_comment_collaborations: Renders as one line, "TYPE, WHERE, YEAR", with a VIEW link. Displayed newest-first. `type` is the kind of work; `where` is the place or label it came out on. The two shared releases (Telepresence, a duo cassette, and Anisotropy, a UNIX SYSTEMS cassette) came back from the old releases.json in 2026-10, at the composer's request; their links are the labels' Bandcamp pages. The two compilation tracks from that file (Celestial Electronics vol.1 Rozselini, Krama Installation 2021) stay off, as one track among many artists.
